Triage (maintainer-authorized one-off pass, 2026-08-09, registered on objectstack#6015): **promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`.** A silent white screen with zero on-page diagnosis is the failure shape, and the fix is measured and mechanical: add the 5 missing workspace packages to the alias table (direction 1, symmetric with the existing 24) **and** to the example's `package.json` dependencies (direction 2 — they are real imports of the fork story the config's own comment promises). The README workaround stays as documentation, not as the fix.

Claim: PM loop round 5 (objectui whole-repo seat, non-v17 queue wave)
Session: `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`
Branch: `claude/issue-3528-console-starter-aliases`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-3528`
File surface: `examples/console-starter` only (`vite.config.ts`, `package.json`, and its README line if the run story changes). Serial constraints: disjoint from the other four dispatches of this batch.
Container & model: S, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`

**Delegated ruling on the card's open fork** (authorization: maintainer's 2026-08-10 delegation to this seat; veto window open until merge): do **both direction 1 and direction 2** — the card itself notes they are not mutually exclusive, and they answer different promises: the aliases keep `pnpm dev` working in-monorepo without a prior build (the example's demo purpose), the dependency declarations keep the fork-out story coherent with the config's own "drop these aliases once published" comment. Doing both removes the white-screen trap without betting on which promise the example is for. Direction 3 (docs-only) stays as the floor that PR #3524 already laid.

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, review of record) — PR #4103, both directions of the delegated ruling implemented.

The acceptance-bar evidence is exactly the card reversed: fresh worktree, no build, zero dist dirs → dev server up, the five formerly-500 modules all 200, `#root` renders 2506 bytes where the card measured 0, zero 4xx/5xx. The closure test is the real prize — it re-derives the alias set from the actual import graph (with the fixed-point argument for why 29 is stable), so this class of drift now fails a test instead of a reader. Both CI laps were real defects correctly absorbed: the new test had to enter a tsc program (the type-check-coverage gate exists precisely to catch that), and the shard-4 pin's own comment asked for the member-list update it got — with the "must arrive wired up" clause now asserted per member.

**Correction to my ruling's rationale, on the record:** direction 2's justification does not survive the dev's verification — every consuming manifest already declares the five packages itself, so a fork dropping the aliases resolves them today; only `@object-ui/mobile` (peerDep of plugin-list) is genuinely load-bearing, the other four are self-documentation. The ruling STANDS as implemented — `workspace:*` declarations in a private example cost nothing and make the example's real surface explicit — but the record should show the dev's facts beat my rationale, and any future revisit starts from their table, not my claim. Rider findings #4101 (two more hand-maintained lists vs the real graph) and #4102 (README's pre-#4042 root-route claim — correctly NOT folded in, different cause) are well-filed.

Flipping ready + auto-merge.
